name: kara_idle
prompt: Idle breathing loop facing right in guard stance: chest rises and falls gently, shoulders bob slightly, red cape and long ponytail sway softly in a light breeze, axe held steady across the body. Feet planted on the same ground line, same framing every frame, seamless loop.

name: kara_hurt
prompt: Hit reaction facing right: frame 1 sharp recoil backward with head snapped back and eyes shut, cape flaring forward; frame 2 knocked back slightly further, knees bending; frames 3-4 recover back toward the guard stance. Feet stay on the ground line.
